name: scikit-learn
one_liner: Machine learning library for supervised and unsupervised learning.
what_it_is: An open source machine learning library supporting supervised and unsupervised learning, per its own documentation, providing dozens of built-in algorithms along with tools for model fitting, data preprocessing, model selection and evaluation.
why_it_matters: It is the shortest path from a dataset to a defensible baseline, and its consistent fit/predict interface means swapping algorithms is a one-line change rather than a rewrite. Knowing it is what stops a problem being handed to a neural network before anyone has checked whether a simpler method answers it.
suitable_for: Establishing a baseline before anything more expensive
Preprocessing and model-selection steps around another framework
not_suitable_for: Deep learning — it is not a neural network framework and does not target GPUs
Datasets too large for one machine
Text or image problems where learned representations are the point
